name: site_id
label: Site
help: The site, from the sites this API token can open. You can also map a site ID (pa_...) from an earlier module.

name: name
label: Name
help: Goal name, up to 120 characters, for example Signed up

name: kind
label: Kind
help: page (visit a page), event (custom event), engagement (scroll or time on page), outbound (outbound link click) or download (file download)

name: match_type
label: Match Type
help: How pattern matches the path (page, engagement), link domain (outbound) or file (download): exact, prefix, glob (*) or regex

name: pattern
label: Pattern
help: Required for page, engagement, outbound and download goals. A path for page and engagement (/pricing, /blog/*), a link domain for outbound (stripe.com) or a file name for download (*.pdf). Read according to match_type

name: hostname
label: Hostname
help: Page goals only. Count the page only on this hostname, for example docs.example.com. Leave empty for any hostname

name: event_name
label: Event Name
help: Required for event goals. The custom event name, for example Signup

name: conditions
label: Conditions
help: Event goals only. A JSON list of property tests that must all match, like [{"key":"plan","operator":"is","value":"pro"}]. Operators: is, is_not, contains, gt, lt.

name: scroll_threshold
label: Scroll Threshold
help: Engagement goals only. Percent of the page scrolled, 1 to 100. The goal is met when this OR time_threshold_seconds is reached

name: time_threshold_seconds
label: Time Threshold Seconds
help: Engagement goals only. Seconds of engaged time on the page. The goal is met when this OR scroll_threshold is reached

name: value_mode
label: Value Mode
help: none, fixed (fixed_value per conversion) or revenue (the event revenue)

name: fixed_value
label: Fixed Value
help: The value of one completion in the site currency, like 49.5. Used when Value Mode is fixed.

name: count_mode
label: Count Mode
help: Value counts once_per_visit or every completion
